title: unified scientific evidence master table
plane: next-phase implementation plan, work package WP1

P0.label: cheap scalar proxy (GFN2-xTB Koopmans orbital energy)
P0.geometry_policy: G1 (single shared geometry, RDKit/MMFF seed, xTB single point)

P1v.label: gas-phase vertical redox-energy proxy (r2SCAN-3c, three states on one geometry)
P1v.geometry_policy: G1 shared by neutral/cation/anion (single point only)
P1v.thermochemistry: vertical: no relaxation and no ZPE for the charged state
P1v.note: R13 alias: the early layer named P1 is this rung (config/scientific_definitions.yaml:legacy_aliases).

P1a.label: gas-phase adiabatic redox thermodynamics (r2SCAN-3c, each charged state relaxed)
P1a.geometry_policy: G2 (per-charge-state r2SCAN-3c Opt started from G1)
P1a.thermochemistry: adiabatic: relaxed charged state, no ZPE
P1a.note: Oxidation axis only: the frozen unbound_anion failure rule excludes the reduction axis.

P2a.label: fixed continuum target: CPCM(SMD, acetonitrile) at G1
P2a.thermochemistry: vertical single points inside the production solvent model

C0.label: free molecule at the G2 geometry (vertical single points)
C0.thermochemistry: vertical single points at the relaxed neutral geometry

C1.label: conditional state [LiM]+ (primary motif), vertical at the optimised complex geometry
C1.thermochemistry: vertical single points on the complex
C1.cost_class: expensive (r2SCAN-3c single point on the complex)

C2.label: first-shell microsolvation [Li(M)2]+ (coordination number 2)
C2.thermochemistry: vertical single points on the 1:2 complex
C2.cost_class: expensive (r2SCAN-3c single point on the 1:2 complex)
C2.note: R13 rename: C2 is the first solvation shell at coordination number 2, not a second shell.

P2eps@5.0.label: bare CPCM dielectric scan (eps = 5.0) at G1
P2eps@5.0.thermochemistry: vertical single points, dielectric-only continuum (no SMD non-electrostatic terms)

P2eps@10.0.label: bare CPCM dielectric scan (eps = 10.0) at G1
P2eps@10.0.thermochemistry: vertical single points, dielectric-only continuum (no SMD non-electrostatic terms)

P2eps@20.0.label: bare CPCM dielectric scan (eps = 20.0) at G1
P2eps@20.0.thermochemistry: vertical single points, dielectric-only continuum (no SMD non-electrostatic terms)

P2eps@40.0.label: bare CPCM dielectric scan (eps = 40.0) at G1
P2eps@40.0.thermochemistry: vertical single points, dielectric-only continuum (no SMD non-electrostatic terms)

checks.detail: 392 property 行全部带 source_file + source_field；0 个来源文件缺失

checks.question: 同一个 pair 的两个模型是否比较同一可解释的目标量？
checks.detail: 1326 个 pair 行全部使用 (quantity=IP / -EA, units=eV, direction=maximise)；没有任何 molecule x axis 在不同 rung 间混用不同目标量

checks.question: P1v 和 P1a 是否有不同的属性定义（而非只改了标签）？
checks.detail: 定义层：几何策略（G1 shared by neutral/cation/anion (single point only) vs G2 (per-charge-state r2SCAN-3c Opt started from G1)）与热化学（vertical: no relaxation and no ZPE for the charged state vs adiabatic: relaxed charged state, no ZPE）都不同；经验层：12 个共同分子上 |IP(P1a)-IP(P1v)| > 0 全部成立，中位 0.3181 eV；还原轴按 unbound_anion 规则全部排除

checks.question: Li-centered reduction 是否被误用为 molecule-centered reduction？
checks.detail: C1/C2 的还原轴严格按 R13 闸门过滤：C1 的 10 个候选里只有 SN 通过闸门，另外 9 个被排除在 primary scope 之外；旧的 all scope 还原排序（含 Li-centered 对象）Kendall tau_b = -0.4666666666666667，说明不加闸门时这条排序轴在物理上不是同一件事

checks.question: 缺失、未收敛、未解析、不适用是否被分别编码？
checks.detail: property 层的 value_status 只用 ok/missing/not_converged/not_applicable；未解析（UNRESOLVED）只作为 pairwise 层的 decision_state 出现，从不写进 value_status
